scenes.title: Four Dragonets on Circular Island
scenes.rationale: The opening introduces the island, the four characters, and their two existing friendships before the festival preparations begin.

scenes.title: Preparing Xena's Performance
scenes.rationale: Recruiting Heska, rehearsing the duet, and trading for jewelry are linked parts of preparing Xena's performance; the visit to Zare stays within this broader preparation scene.

scenes.title: Triumphs and Disasters at the Jubilee
scenes.rationale: The opening ceremony, Heska's disastrous debut, and Zeno's rap-battle victory form the public festival sequence, before the friends withdraw for dinner.

scenes.title: Dinner and the Strange Silence
scenes.rationale: The shared meal is interrupted by unusual sensations, leading directly to an aerial search and the flight to the Wanderer; end at arrival before examining the egg.

scenes.title: The Egg and the Meaning of Home
scenes.rationale: Keep the examination, embraces, shared vision, and temporary changes in abilities together as the encounter with the egg on the palm.
